info.title: Resume Optimizer local API
info.description: Local-only adapter over the Resume Optimizer services, for the React frontend.

get.description: Succeeds only with a valid session token (checked by the guard).

put.description: Save the whole profile as a new version. Any change clears confirmation.

delete.description: Delete the profile, all its versions and role profiles. The user must type DELETE.

post.description: Load the fictional sample profile. Only offered when no profile exists, as in Streamlit.

schema.title: Response List Versions Api V1 Profile Versions Get

post.description: Validate an uploaded profile JSON (raw request body). Nothing is saved; PUT /profile saves it.

schema.title: Response List Roles Api V1 Role Profiles Get

post.description: Extract JD text from an uploaded file sent as the raw request body (``?filename=`` names it).
Best-effort fetch of one public page. Never bypasses sign-in or bot checks; failures suggest pasting.

schema.title: Response List Captures Api V1 Captures Get
Response List Jobs Api V1 Jobs Get

409.description: Looks like a saved job (code 'duplicate', details.duplicates)

patch.description: Edit details and JD text. Status and dates are changed on the tracker (PATCH /tracker/{id}).

delete.description: Delete the job with its analysis, match report, resume versions and exported files.

post.description: Run the deterministic parser. Re-analyzing replaces the user's edits, so it needs ``replace: true``.

put.description: Save the user's corrections. Any change clears confirmation.

post.description: Run (or re-run) matching. The user's judgements are kept where their evidence still exists.

put.description: Record the user's judgement. Supported and partial must cite evidence from the profile.

schema.title: Response List Job Versions Api V1 Jobs  Job Id  Resumes Get

get.description: Every resume version across jobs, newest first.

schema.title: Response List All Versions Api V1 Resumes Get

post.description: Exactly what would be sent to the AI provider. Nothing is sent by this call.
Save edits as a NEW version. Header facts (titles, employers, dates) are edited in the profile.
Approve after the user confirmed accuracy. Versions with validation errors can't be approved.
Render DOCX and PDF with the template and paper size from Settings, then run the export checks.

get.description: Stream an exported file. The path comes from the stored export record, never from the client.

schema.title: Response Duplicates Api V1 Tracker Duplicates Get

post.description: Keep one record, fill its blanks from the other, append the other's notes, delete the other.

get.description: Counts and recent items from stored records only. There is no activity log or ATS score.

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: The JD text changed after this analysis was made

replace.title: Replace
replace.description: Must be true to discard an existing analysis and re-analyze

filled.title: Filled
filled.description: Blank job fields filled in from the JD; the user should check them

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: The user confirmed they read the resume and it is accurate

Bullet.title: Bullet
Bullet.description: One factual statement about an experience or project.

entry_id.title: Entry Id
entry_id.description: Evidence ID of the experience/project entry

evidence_id.title: Evidence Id
evidence_id.description: First evidence ID of the bullet

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be the exact word DELETE

consent.title: Consent
consent.description: Required with use_ai: the user agreed to send the preview

parser.title: Parser
parser.description: Which parser produced the first draft

jd_hash.title: Jd Hash
jd_hash.description: Hash of the JD text analyzed; a mismatch means the analysis is stale

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Parser notes, e.g. embedded AI instructions

confirmed_at.title: Confirmed At
confirmed_at.description: When the user reviewed and confirmed

import_notes.title: Import Notes
import_notes.description: Warnings from import, e.g. 'extraction may be incomplete'

applied_on.title: Applied On
applied_on.description: When the user applied (entered by the user)

resume_version_id.title: Resume Version Id
resume_version_id.description: Resume version used for this application

on_duplicate.title: On Duplicate
on_duplicate.description: check: 409 if it looks like a saved job; separate: save anyway; merge: update merge_into_id with this import

text_notes.title: Text Notes
text_notes.description: Notes about the text as imported; recomputed on save

source_notes.title: Source Notes
source_notes.description: Notes about the import; saved with the job

JobDraft.title: JobDraft
JobDraft.description: Imported text held for review. Nothing is saved until ``POST /jobs``.

JobStatus.title: JobStatus
JobStatus.description: User-selected application status. The app never applies on the user's behalf.

confirmed_at.title: Confirmed At
confirmed_at.description: When the user last reviewed and confirmed this version

analysis_fingerprint.title: Analysis Fingerprint
analysis_fingerprint.description: Hash of the analysis content matched; mismatch => stale

status.description: Effective status (the user's judgement if set)

formula.title: Formula
formula.description: How coverage is calculated. It is not an ATS score or hiring probability.

blockers.title: Blockers
blockers.description: Why matching can't run yet; empty when it can

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: A MasterProfile. Validated after removed evidence is pruned, so deleting an item that skills link to works as in Streamlit

expected_version.title: Expected Version
expected_version.description: profile_version the edit was based on; null if none exists

text.title: Text
text.description: The requirement as stated or summarized

source_excerpt.title: Source Excerpt
source_excerpt.description: JD text this requirement was taken from

RequirementRow.title: RequirementRow
RequirementRow.description: One edited requirement. Rows without ``id`` are new; omitted existing rows are deleted.

source_text.title: Source Text
source_text.description: The master-profile text this bullet comes from

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Checker notes, e.g. a rejected rewrite

ResumeEntry.title: ResumeEntry
ResumeEntry.description: An experience or project. Header fields are copied from the profile, never generated.

parent_id.title: Parent Id
parent_id.description: Version this one was edited from

match_profile_version.title: Match Profile Version
match_profile_version.description: Profile version the match report used

omitted.title: Omitted
omitted.description: What was left out and why

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Optional headline override; must be supported by the profile

RoleProfile.title: RoleProfile
RoleProfile.description:
A named selection/ordering of master-profile evidence (e.g. 'ML Engineer').

Holds references only; it is never a competing source of truth.

values.description: Effective values (local-only mode forces some off)

saved.description: Values to show in the form: the saved choice where local-only overrides it

locked.title: Locked
locked.description: setting -> why it can't be changed here (set by an environment variable)

keys_detected.title: Keys Detected
keys_detected.description: API key environment variable -> whether it is set (never the value)

evidence_ids.title: Evidence Ids
evidence_ids.description: IDs of experiences/projects/bullets that demonstrate this skill

Skill.title: Skill
Skill.description:
A skill the user has. ``aliases`` are exact alternative spellings
(e.g. 'k8s' for 'Kubernetes'), NOT related concepts.

blockers.title: Blockers
blockers.description: Why a draft can't be generated yet; empty when it can

value.title: Value
value.description: Verified value as the user states it, e.g. '35%'

VerifiedMetric.title: VerifiedMetric
VerifiedMetric.description: A quantitative outcome the user has verified. Never generated.

validation.description: Null if the profile, analysis or report is missing
